configure_logging: configure the surya logger with a stream handler, formatter, and log level from settings
get_logger: get the surya logger instance for use throughout the application
test_configure_logging: test the configure_logging function sets up the logger with correct handler and formatter
test_get_logger: test the get_logger function returns a logger instance named surya
refactor_configure_logging: refactor configure_logging to accept custom handler and formatter parameters
